import requests
# Cross-check via Ensembl REST for human DNAJC11
r = requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/DNAJC11?content-type=application/json", timeout=30)
d = r.json()
print("Ensembl human DNAJC11:", d.get("id"), d.get("display_name"), d.get("species"), d.get("biotype"))

# Also check whether any Mus musculus entry exists for DNAJC11
r2 = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:DNAJC11+AND+organism_id:10090&format=json&fields=accession,organism_name,organism_id&size=3", timeout=30)
print("Mouse DNAJC11 entries:", r2.text[:600])</execute></solution>
